name: Fantasy Realms

categories.label: Base strength
categories.help: Add up the printed base strength of every card in your final hand, skipping any card that was blanked.

categories.label: Bonuses
categories.help: Total of all bonus points your hand earns from card effects.

categories.label: Penalties
categories.help: Total of all penalty points your hand suffers, entered as a positive number.

notes: Read from the publisher (WizKids) PDF. Scores a hand of base strength plus bonuses minus penalties; the lowest base strength wins a tie. The rulebook does not state a player count, so 2-6 comes from the box and is unverified here. Individual card effects (blanking, clearing, Cursed Items, Extra Suits, Chaos Realms variants) are worked out by the players; enter the resulting totals.
